subject: Split billing + surge protection amendment — ClearPath renewal top-up
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearpath.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@clearpath.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: billing structure and surge protection - ClearPath

Hi Tessa,

We're kicking off our renewal discussions and there are a couple of items procurement flagged that I'd like to get in front of you:

- We have three internal cost centers that need to be billed separately starting next quarter (Clinical Ops / R&D / Platform). Can Redwood split invoices or provide department-specific billing codes?
- We expect a seasonal surge window in November—would like a surge protection/add-on that guarantees capacity or a preferential surge rate so our product teams don't hit throttling mid-release.

Attached is our Q3 usage snapshot to help size the ask. Can you outline options and any price impact (uplift, pro-rate rules) so procurement can review? We have a tentative renewal target of 10/15.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Director, Cloud Engineering
ClearPath Health

Attachments: ClearPath_Usage_Report_Q3.csv

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearpath.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 03 Oct 2026 12:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: billing structure and surge protection - ClearPath

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the usage file, that helps a lot. High level options we can offer:

1) Split billing by cost center (recommended): create three invoice lines mapped to your department codes. No technical work on your side — we just need the destination PO numbers / billing emails. Price impact: none for accounting split; any per-department committed uplift follows your overall committed capacity allocation.

2) Dedicated surge protection add-on: a 30% reserved burst pool for the Nov window at a +12% uplift on top of current committed rate. Alternatively, a pay-as-you-go overage cap (soft cap) with a 25% premium only when used.

3) Short-term top-up (mid-contract): we can add a pro-rated reserved bucket for the remainder of your term. We can apply a one-time bridging credit if you convert that top-up into an annualized commit at next renewal.

I've attached a short proposal with line-item pricing and two implementation paths (split invoices vs. department tagging). If you want to keep invoicing simple, we can also provide a consolidated invoice with department-specific memo fields.

Next steps:
- Confirm which billing approach you prefer (split invoices vs. memos)
- Confirm whether you'd like the reserved surge add-on or P95 overage protections
- If split invoices, send the PO numbers for each cost center and we'll draft the amendment

I'll also loop in Ben and Karthik to weigh in on pricing flexibility. Can we set a 30-min call tomorrow to close this?

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposal_split_billing_v1.pdf

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 04 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal: billing structure and surge protection - ClearPath

Tessa / Karthik — quick pricing thought:

- Offer path A (minimal friction): split invoices, no uplift. Add a surge protection SKU priced at +10% (discountable).
- Offer path B (commit conversion incentive): allow a mid-contract top-up converted to annualized commit at renewal; apply a 5% loyalty discount if they co-term all cost centers at renewal.
- Consider a one-off voucher (equal to 1 month of committed spend) as a bridging credit if they sign the amendment and PO within 7 business days.

This gives the customer an easy option and a commercial incentive to lock more capacity.

Ben

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearpath.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@clearpath.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Split billing + surge protection amendment — ClearPath renewal top-up

Tessa — thanks for the options, appreciate the clarity. Procurement likes Path B (convert top-up to commit at renewal) with the co-term discount. A couple of follow ups:

- Can the bridging credit be applied across cost centers or does it have to attach to one PO? Procurement prefers a single amendment that covers all three departments.
- We need to confirm whether the surge protection charge is pro-rated for Oct/Nov if we activate mid-term.

I've attached a draft PO to get the internal approvals moving. If you can confirm the pro-rata rules and whether the credit can be allocated across the amendment I'll route it for signatures.

Best,
Alyssa

Attachments: ClearPath_PO_draft.pdf

From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@clearpath.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Split billing + surge protection amendment — ClearPath renewal top-up

Alyssa — great, glad Path B is acceptable. Quick confirms:

- Bridging credit: we can issue a single bridging voucher (one-off) that your procurement team can allocate across the three cost centers in your amendment. We'll record the allocation in the amendment but allow your finance team to distribute the credit internally.
- Pro-ration for surge add-on: any add-on activated mid-term will be pro-rated to the day, using a 30-day month basis for the remainder of the current term. If you convert that top-up to an annualized commit at renewal, we will credit the pro-rated amount back as part of the conversion.

Next steps I will kick off:
1) Draft amendment (single document covering all three cost centers) and attach the bridging voucher language. Link to DocuSign will be provided.
2) Send updated commercial summary with per-department invoice examples and pro-rate math.
3) 30-min billing sync with your procurement + finance (how's Wed 10/7 11am PT?).

If that schedule works I'll drop the DocuSign link and post the HubSpot deal note (see link).

Thanks — talk soon,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: 555-867-1010
E: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
